notes: The programme page of the supplied pages for 'International Economics and Finance' shows the content of the Finance BSc (3 yrs, 180 CFU, offered entirely in English); no separate page for the International Economics and Finance programme was supplied. The application route for a non-EU applicant is the Bocconi Apply2B online portal; the pages do not mention Universitaly pre-enrolment for this programme. Two more selection rounds (Winter Session 25 November 2026 – 26 January 2027) exist for international applicants; the first round is given. Tuition was left out: the only figure (€ 17,700 per year for first-year Bachelor of Science or Law students) is a general institution-wide amount, and no quote ties this programme to a non-EU country or programme group.

note.en: Admission is based on the selection test score (Bocconi online test, SAT or ACT) and on the third-last and second-last year GPA. A minimum score of 17 is required.
